title: Content draft — writer output, pre-publication
description: content-engine/drafts/{slug}.json. Wraps canonical v2 content with the provenance needed to audit it. A draft is NEVER written to wordpress/themes/*/content/ — promotion is the publish gate's job in a later phase, and the separation is what makes a draft reviewable before it can reach a page.

status.description: A draft is never 'published' here. promoted is recorded by the publish gate.

angle_id.description: The approved angle this draft was written from. A draft with no approved angle cannot exist.

claim_ids_used.description: Every allowed claim the prose actually relies on. A factual statement not traceable to one of these is a validation failure.

coverage.description: What the draft claims to cover, checked against the brief by validate-draft.py.

self_check.description: The writer's own assessment against the Phase 3C-3 checklist. Recorded so a reviewer can see what the writer believed, and disagree with it.

content.description: Canonical v2 content. Validated against location/service/home schema by validate-draft.py — the same contract production content must satisfy, so a draft cannot be shaped differently from what a page accepts.

_authoring_package.description: The complete instruction set the writer was permitted to see, embedded so a draft can be audited against what it was actually told. Written by write-content.py; not authored by hand.
